title: Interview Joseph Heinen on Blockchain-based Artworks
descriptions: The interview was conducted to gain information about the interviewee’s NFT artwork experience. This topic served as the interviewer’s main topic in her Master’s thesis research. In the interview, Heinen explains his path as a digital professional thus far and experiences with NFTs in the collection of LACMA. Finally, the topic of preservation of blockchain-based artworks is discussed.
